name: system-of-record
description: A convention for repos that hold the authoritative record of something real: sources vs renderings, the evidence rule, the capture rule, greppable uncertainty markers, a fact-routing table, and a declared perimeter. Works whether the record is the whole repo or a layer inside a code repo.
